negative_reviews.author: James Matthews
negative_reviews.text: Food was amazing but the service was absolutely shocking we went in 27 October 2026 at 6pm and the staff were beyond useless

negative_reviews.author: Kishore
negative_reviews.text:
We visited Maki & Ramen at the O2 around 7:15 PM for dinner, and unfortunately, the experience was extremely disappointing.

The restaurant was almost empty, yet the floors were visibly dirty, and there was a foul smell throughout the place, making it very uncomfortable to dine in. The food was equally disappointing. The chicken yakisoba was overwhelmingly sweet, and the dynamite prawns were noticeably smaller and completely different from the ones we had previously enjoyed at the Soho branch.

Our previous visit to Maki & Ramen in Soho was fantastic, and we had absolutely no complaints about the food or overall experience. Unfortunately, the O2 branch was a completely different story and fell far below our expectations.

It’s disappointing to see such a huge difference in quality between two branches of the same restaurant. I hope the management takes this feedback seriously and improves the cleanliness, food consistency, and overall dining experience.
